name: René Repasi - Après le § 2 - Am 28
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on the 28th Regime: a new legal framework for innovative companies
part_text: 2 a. Underlines that the choice of legal basis should ensure the broadest possible consensus among Member States; considers that recourse to legal bases requiring unanimity in the Council should not be excluded where the proposed measures significantly affect core aspects of national company law;
